title: Supalite 0.9.0 signedUrl/signedURL bug: redeemed content length also differs across targets
rationale: Confirmed this sprint against BOTH real targets: supabase/storage-api v1.70.3 returns the JSON key `signedURL` (capital URL) from POST /storage/v1/object/sign/*, which is what @supabase/storage-js@2.97.0 reads to build createSignedUrl()'s returned URL, so redemption through the official client returns the real uploaded bytes (HTTP 200). @supabase/lite@0.9.0 returns `signedUrl` (lowercase) from the same endpoint; the client leaves its URL undefined and the scenario redeems `${baseUrl}/storage/v1undefined`, which Supalite serves as its admin-dashboard HTML with HTTP 200 — a successful-looking response carrying the wrong content. This is a genuine cross-target divergence at step.redeem /bytesDigest: identical inputs, both HTTP 200, different bytes. The same bug reproduces identically on supalite-pglite and supalite-postgres (see docs/TARGETS.md); a separate entry would be added if a scenario exercises those as the candidate.

evidence.value: Raw sign endpoint, supabase-local: {"signedURL":"/object/sign/b1/f.txt?token=..."} -> client redeems real bytes. Raw sign endpoint, Supalite 0.9.0: {"signedUrl":"..."} -> client URL undefined -> redeems admin HTML. Reproduced in packages/targets/test/integration/peer-storage-local.test.ts.
